acceptanceCriteria: Document whether canonical in-repository instruction symlinks are deliberately unsupported, with safe direct canonical-file fallback.
If support is accepted, separately specify containment, immutable target binding and out-of-root/cycle refusal before implementing.
body: Observed capability gap, not a confirmed security bug. VanillaTwisted canonically uses AGENTS.md -> CLAUDE.md. Core build 456, source f0d0e6106d8f7ffeaac46339ba274df3aafc712f, darwin/arm64. After explicit index refresh, printf input {"hook_event_name":"UserPromptSubmit","prompt":"Use corvint on CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md","cwd":"/Users/russelllewis/projects/VanillaTwisted"} to corvint adapter codex reports AGENTS.md unavailable in governance and task_evidence, while CLAUDE.md is explicit-path evidence. corvint adopt separately retains symlink gap. Current consumer fallback is read canonical CLAUDE.md directly and preserve symlink. Determine intended safe behavior/documentation for tracked, within-repository canonical links; do not relax containment checks merely to eliminate uncertainty. Receipt: /Users/russelllewis/projects/VanillaTwisted/.agent-evidence/corvint-testbed-20261011/hook.json.
title: Consumer guidance gap: canonical in-repository AGENTS.md symlink omitted from Codex governance context
